sql: SELECT s.symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS method_count FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.is_public = FALSE AND s.file_id IN (SELECT f.file_id FROM code.files f WHERE f.is_test = FALSE) GROUP BY s.symbol_id ORDER BY method_count DESC, s.symbol_id ASC LIMIT 5
